name: Geometric shapes and bilateral symmetry mirrored drawing
description: Verify drawing straight Lines, 2:1 Isometric lines, Rectangles, and Ellipses, and executing bilateral symmetry across horizontal and vertical mirror axes.

planSteps.description: Verify the drawing workspace is ready with canvas centered
Click the Line tool button in the left toolbar (or press L on keyboard)
Click and drag diagonally on the canvas to draw a crisp Bresenham line
Click the 2:1 Iso Line tool button in the left toolbar (or press J on keyboard)
Click and drag horizontally across the canvas to draw an authentic 2:1 isometric pixel line
Click the Rectangle tool button in the left toolbar (or press U on keyboard)
Click and drag across the canvas to draw a rectangular boundary
Toggle the Horizontal Symmetry button (labeled 'H') in the top context options bar
Verify the vertical red symmetry guide axis appears down the center of the canvas
Select the Pen tool and draw on the left half of the canvas
Verify mirrored strokes are simultaneously rendered on the right half of the canvas
